threshold_policy: For each model and seed, the validation-selected threshold is frozen before every test sensitivity calculation and is never reselected for a sensitivity level.
event_density_strata: Within-seed tertiles of measured connected-to-fragmented event rate on the fixed test runs.
interpretation: Descriptive post-review event-scoring robustness analysis, not part of the original locked confirmatory family.
completion_rule: All three models must cover all sensitivity levels for all 20 revision seeds; partial results must not be cited.
test_role: descriptive post-review scoring robustness; thresholds frozen within each model/seed
